Long divided, the realm must unite; long united, it must divide.
Ancestral seal scripts glow in the dark, one name after another.
ui.opening.intro.p2:
Replaying that old Three Kingdoms classic again?
Regrets can be rewritten.
We have prepared a dream observation seat and a holographic helmet. A few stubborn destined generals who are willing to follow you are waiting.

The familiar pixel map, the portraits of the six great lords...
Six-color traces of light are creeping into old memories.
ui.opening.intro.p4:
The white dot spreads into a vortex, and old souls are sucked into the rift of fate,
the gacha wheel flying in from afar.

tactic.desc.tactic-cavalry-shock: 騎兵們一夾馬腹就像離弦的箭，沿著筆直的路線轟隆隆衝過去，擋路的敵人只能自求多福。適合在對面排成一列時開場突襲，一口氣把前排撞得七零八落。
tactic.desc.tactic-spear-phalanx: 長槍手一個挨一個站成整排，槍尖齊刷刷往前一伸，活像一面會扎人的牆。開打前先把相鄰的弟兄們排好陣型，讓大家站穩腳步、守得更安心。
tactic.desc.tactic-archer-volley: 弓手們同時拉滿弓弦，一放手，漫天箭矢像突然下起的急雨，直直往前方灑去。適合對付排成一列的敵軍，一口氣把整條線上的人都照顧到。
tactic.desc.tactic-fire-scheme: 諸葛亮羽扇一搖，乾草、油罐早就悄悄擺好，只等敵人踏進那一格。火苗一起，對面立刻體會什麼叫熱情款待，適合在敵人聚在同一點時集中燒一把。
tactic.desc.tactic-morale-rally: 主將策馬繞陣一圈，戰鼓敲得震天響，連後排伙夫都忍不住挺起胸膛。開戰前或陣腳不穩時用最合適，替我方全體提振士氣，讓大家打起仗來更有精神。
tactic.desc.tactic-river-ambush: 蘆葦叢裡突然冒出一排小船，船上的人早就等著你路過，連招呼都省了。專門對付靠近身邊的敵人，趁他們還沒回過神，先送上一份出其不意的見面禮。
tactic.desc.tactic-battle-roar: 主將深吸一口氣，一聲怒喝直衝敵陣，震得對面連手上的兵器都握不穩。適合在開戰時對全體敵軍先聲奪人，讓他們一時動彈不得，我方趁機佔上風。
tactic.desc.tactic-dragon-pierce: 長槍一抖，槍尖像拖著一條龍呼嘯而出，沿著直線直奔前方對手。單挑時搶先出手很夠力，遇到敵人排成一列也能順手一併招呼。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-lance-thrust: 槍兵低身蹬地，長槍像筷子夾菜一樣又快又準地直直送出。沿著正前方一線穿過去，單挑時專找對手破綻，順便也能戳到後面排隊的人。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-cavalry-charge: 騎兵們低伏馬背齊聲吆喝，馬蹄踏得大地像在打鼓，沿著一條直線轟隆隆衝進敵陣。想打亂前排或是直搗後方的弱點，朝著正面一路殺過去就對了。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-dragon-gall: 單騎殺進千軍萬馬，懷裡還抱著小主公，膽子大到敵人都懷疑他把怕字忘在家裡。鎖定一名敵人正面硬碰硬，單挑時用來壓制對手最有效。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-zhao-spear: 趙子龍一桿銀槍抖出幾朵槍花，花還沒看完，槍尖已經到了對手胸前。沿著直線直取目標，單挑對決時拿來搶先出手最合適。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-lone-rider: 單人匹馬直接殺進敵陣，四周的人還沒回過神，就被馬蹄和長槍掃出一圈空地。適合在被團團圍住時主動突圍，把身邊的敵人一口氣撞開。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-combo-attack: 一刀剛劈完，下一刀已經接上，快得像在表演連環快閃，對手連喊暫停的空檔都沒有。適合在單挑時盯住同一個敵人猛打，一口氣把壓力全部補滿。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-haste: 全軍腳下像是裝了風火輪，旗幟甩在身後，連塵土都追不上隊伍的屁股。想讓整支部隊搶在敵人前頭抵達戰場時，先來這一手準沒錯。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-shield: 全軍盾牌齊舉，瞬間排成一面會走路的銅牆鐵壁。敵人的箭雨打上去，只剩叮叮噹噹的伴奏。開戰前幫全隊加強防禦，扛得住才打得久。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-eight-array: 諸葛亮把石塊隨手一擺，眼前頓時成了一座繞不出去的迷宮，連追兵都轉到懷疑人生。開局先替自己布好陣勢，守得穩、站得住，後面的調度才有底氣。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-heal: 軍醫提著藥箱衝進戰場，三兩下就把受傷的將領包紮完畢，連華佗看了都想收他當徒弟。戰況吃緊時對單一友軍使用，幫他補回體力，讓他再撐上一陣子。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-inspire: 主帥站上高台，戰鼓一通接一通，擂得連旗子都跟著節拍搖擺。全軍聽得熱血沸騰，連昨晚沒睡飽的都瞬間精神抖擻，適合開戰前或僵持時替全隊補一波士氣。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-slow: 軍師輕搖羽扇，敵人腳下的地面忽然變得像剛下過雨的泥巴路，每一步都走得又黏又慢。對付衝太快的單一目標特別好用，先把他的速度拖住，再慢慢收拾。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-taunt: 對著敵將遠遠喊話，還附贈一套女裝當禮物，活像當年諸葛亮對司馬懿的那一招。適合拿來對付單一難纏的對手，讓他氣到亂了章法、出手失準。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-sworn-fury: 兄弟被欺負了，桃園的誓言瞬間湧上心頭，三騎並肩朝前方扇形猛衝。敵人擠成一團的時候最好用，一口氣把前排陣型撞得七零八落。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-wei-might: 青龍偃月刀一抬，對面光看架勢就先腿軟，據說連曹操都動過搬家避風頭的念頭。單挑時對準一名敵人正面壓上去，先用名聲贏下氣勢。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-empty-fort: 城門大開，諸葛亮端坐城樓撫琴，臉上寫著「我很閒，快來」。敵軍越看越心虛，腳步一個比一個慢。兵力吃緊時拿來唬人最划算，用氣勢逼對手自己退一步。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-fire-attack: 火箭劃破夜空，精準落進敵營，一把火燒得對手比赤壁那晚還熱鬧。專挑單一目標點火，適合在正面開打前先讓對方手忙腳亂。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-red-cliff: 東風一起，江面上的戰船連成一串，火苗順著風勢一路點名。單點猛燒一個敵人，趁對手手忙腳亂時打出一波大傷害，拿來收拾最礙眼的那個目標最順手。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-chain-link: 龐統笑著說船綁在一起比較不暈浪，整支艦隊就這樣被串成一串粽子。專挑一名敵人下套，讓他處處受制、動彈不得，適合先手牽制對方的關鍵人物。
tactic.desc.tactic-insp-night-raid: 熄了火把、裹了馬蹄，一隊人影趁著月黑風高摸進敵營，專挑睡到一半的那位下手。適合在對方毫無防備時盯住單一目標，打得他醒來還在懷疑人生。

child.talk.line1: You ask who your child admires most. "Zhuge Liang! He borrowed arrows with straw boats, so I'm borrowing your coins for candy."
child.talk.line2: "My teacher says Cao Chong was a genius for weighing an elephant, so let me weigh your snack stash." You hug the candy jar tighter.
child.talk.line3: Your child asks, dead serious: "Liu Bei visited the thatched hut three times. Will you knock on my door three times to invite me to dinner?"

year1.goal.first_battle.name: First Blood
year1.goal.first_battle.action: Win your first battle (don't worry, the other side is even more nervous!)
year1.goal.first_battle.toast: First Blood! The other side just realized you were serious.
year1.goal.first_recruit.name: Hire Some Help
year1.goal.first_recruit.action: Recruit your first general (conquering alone is tiring, get a helper!)
year1.goal.first_recruit.toast: Hire Some Help! Someone finally carries your luggage.
year1.goal.first_affairs.name: Diligent Steward
year1.goal.first_affairs.action: Finish your first domestic affair (earn grocery money before raising kids!)
year1.goal.first_affairs.toast: Diligent Steward! Your first grocery money is in, the kids' snacks are safe.
year1.goal.first_talk.name: Doting Parent
year1.goal.first_talk.action: Interact with a child once (hear what snack they are plotting to steal)
year1.goal.first_talk.toast: Doting Parent! The kid actually talks to you. Hide the snacks next time.
year1.goal.first_spouse.name: Settle Down
year1.goal.first_spouse.action: Take your first spouse (the matchmaker is already knocking, no more flying solo!)
year1.goal.first_spouse.toast: Settle Down! The matchmaker can clock out; now the family nags you about other things.

year1.goal.top3_sprint.action: Reach the top 3 at the year-end ranking (give it a shot! 1,000 silver and 80 jade are waving)
year1.goal.top3_sprint.toast: Hall of Fame! Top 3 secured, even the gongs are more excited than you.
year1.goal.top3_sprint.consolation: Not in the top 3, but the judges slipped you some tea money. Try again next year!
year1.panel.done: All Year 1 goals done. Rookie Grand Slam!
year1.panel.wrapup: Year 1 goals settled. Keep going next year

ui.ceremony.act3.grandSlam: Rookie Grand Slam! Nearly every Year 1 goal cleared, even veterans want to take notes!
ui.ceremony.crowd.cheer.1: This ranking is more thrilling than my year-end bonus. Clap first, ask later!
ui.ceremony.crowd.cheer.2: Keep clapping, noble houses. Applause is free and today it is all-you-can-clap!
ui.ceremony.crowd.cheer.3: Number one, do not gloat yet. Someone is coming for your seat next year.
ui.ceremony.crowd.cheer.4: Bet you a bag of sunflower seeds the dark horse is in this very room!
ui.ceremony.crowd.cheer.5: Missed the list? Chin up, you are mostly here for the party anyway.
ui.ceremony.crowd.cheer.6: Winners, smile! This one is going straight into the family album.
ui.ceremony.crowd.win.1: Whoa, we made the list! {0} just dropped every sunflower seed!
ui.ceremony.crowd.win.2: Everybody shout it so the whole hall hears: congratulations!
ui.ceremony.crowd.win.3: {0} is booking next year's victory banquet. Who is paying for the wine?
ui.ceremony.crowd.lose.1: (pats your shoulder) It is fine, {0} watches this list every year. You get used to it.
ui.ceremony.crowd.lose.2: (snickers) Shh, not so loud. Next year's champion might just be you.
ui.ceremony.crowd.lose.3: (hands over seeds) Here, have a snack to calm down. It is on {0}.

battle.resource.food.tip: Provisions are the rations you brought to this battle. Every unit eats on deploy, it does not regrow mid-battle, and leftovers are refunded afterwards.

battle.deploy.toast.foodEmpty: The granary is bare... no food, no more units!

battle.deploy.sheet.title.food: Not enough provisions to send this card yet

ui.seasonNews.item.birth: {0} welcomed a new heir: one more mouth to feed, one more red packet to hand out
ui.seasonNews.item.promotion: My lord was promoted to {0}. The title got longer; the pay is still on its way
ui.seasonNews.item.battle_win: {0} came back from battle victorious. The bragging speech is reportedly already printed
ui.seasonNews.item.recruit: {0} joined the ranks. The resume is wildly exaggerated; hired anyway
ui.seasonNews.item.battle_lose: {0} lost a battle. Officially, the ground was slippery
ui.seasonNews.item.retire: {0} retired to teach school. The students are terrified
ui.seasonNews.item.dispatch_fail: {0} botched the mission. Reason given: a goose on the road
ui.seasonNews.filler.1: A quiet season. Even the geese slept soundly
ui.seasonNews.filler.2: No big news this season, only small news that is not fit to print
ui.seasonNews.filler.3: Our reporter staked out all season and only caught my lord daydreaming
ui.seasonNews.roast.good.Brave: Pretty good season, right? I said following our lord was a sure bet!
ui.seasonNews.roast.good.Wise: I saw this coming. I just did not want to brag.
ui.seasonNews.roast.good.Loyal: All thanks to our lord. I merely ran a few errands.
ui.seasonNews.roast.good.Playful: Ha! I am in a great mood. Snacks are on this issue!
ui.seasonNews.roast.bad.Brave: Defeat is part of war. I will win it back next season!
ui.seasonNews.roast.bad.Wise: I reviewed it. Next time I check the ground first.
ui.seasonNews.roast.bad.Loyal: That was my fault. Punish me, just do not cut my pay.
ui.seasonNews.roast.bad.Playful: Ugh, that is not my best angle for the newspaper.
ui.seasonNews.roast.quiet.Brave: So bored. Give me something to do, my lord!
ui.seasonNews.roast.quiet.Wise: No news is good news. More time to read.
ui.seasonNews.roast.quiet.Loyal: I am guarding the city. Sleep well, my lord.
ui.seasonNews.roast.quiet.Playful: No news? Then let me make some.

ui.general.quip.cao-cao: Hauling the emperor around like a rubber stamp for his office. Efficient, sure, but nobody's signing up for the next team-building trip.
ui.general.quip.liu-bei: Started out weaving mats and selling sandals, then built an empire on tears and networking. Honestly, the resume beats the diploma.
ui.general.quip.sun-quan: Holds the southeast like a fortress, but every war needs a full court meeting and a poll first. Democracy, but make it slow.
ui.general.quip.zhuge-liang: Sang an empty fortress like a concert to scare off enemies. Pure vibes, pure psychological warfare, zero refunds.
ui.general.quip.zhou-yu: Hears one wrong note and turns around. Perfect pitch, and a rival who's also a genius, which is the real problem.
ui.general.quip.guan-yu: Crossed five passes and beat six generals just to get back to his brother. Loyalty like that, every company wants to hire.
ui.general.quip.zhang-fei: One roar scares off the pursuers. Volume is his cheat code, and he's never once tried to turn it down.
ui.general.quip.zhao-yun: Seven in, seven out to rescue the lord's son. A model employee who's brave to the core and never causes trouble.
ui.general.quip.lu-bu: Changes bosses more often than phones. Still, nobody wants to be his coworker when the fighting starts.
ui.general.quip.sima-yi: Faked illness for ten years, then clocked in one last time and took over the whole company. Now that's patience.
ui.general.quip.dian-wei: Swings twin halberds and works as the lord's human bulletproof vest. The gold standard for bodyguards everywhere.
ui.general.quip.xu-zhu: Shirtless tiger-fan who charges into battle. His muscles show up to the meeting before his brain does.
ui.general.quip.huang-zhong: Past sixty and still hitting targets a hundred paces out. Proof that veterans can outperform the young hires.
ui.general.quip.ma-chao: Handsome, strong, and riding a splendid horse. Today he'd be a top idol who also happens to win the sports title.
ui.general.quip.lu-xun: Burned a whole camp down with one fire, and a scholar who fights harder than the generals. The ultimate plot twist.
ui.general.quip.taishi-ci: A bowman who keeps his word, delivering on time every time. Even the couriers can't beat that.
ui.general.quip.zhang-liao: Eight hundred men scared a hundred thousand. Small force, big win, a textbook case of doing more with less.
ui.general.quip.xu-huang: Charges straight in and refuses to play favorites. So disciplined that even the boss can't find a flaw.
ui.general.quip.cao-ren: Defending walls is his day job. He can close the gates, make tea, and watch the enemy stare in frustration.
ui.general.quip.pang-tong: A phoenix hatchling who got sent off to chain the ships on day one, then nearly got burned by his own plan.
ui.general.quip.guo-jia: A genius strategist who predicts everything, but who stays up all night and has zero health management.
ui.general.quip.xun-yu: Knows everything about being a model advisor but can never say no to the boss, so he just goes quiet in the end.
ui.general.quip.jia-xu: A hidden poison who switches sides like switching jobs, yet his paycheck never bounces.
ui.general.quip.zhang-he: A strategist who adapts on the fly, always reading the battlefield's winds and moods better than anyone.
ui.general.quip.yu-jin: An old-school soldier who sticks to the rules by the book. Just unlucky, and it shows.
ui.general.quip.cao-ang: The lord's eldest son, warm and filial, but he left the stage way too early. A total sweetheart of a character.
ui.general.quip.xiahou-dun: The one-eyed hero who ate his own eyeball. Calling him brave is one way to put it; he really treated his eye like a snack.
ui.general.quip.xiahou-yuan: Three hundred li in a day, a thousand in six. Even couriers have to bow and call him senior.
ui.general.quip.wei-yan: His bold plan through Ziwu Valley keeps getting rejected. Always the guy with ideas that nobody ever listens to.
ui.general.quip.jiang-wei: Carries on his master's will, nine campaigns against the Central Plains. He's tired, but never once quits.
ui.general.quip.deng-ai: Sneaked across Yinping and shocked everyone. Stutters, but can still wow everyone with a map.
ui.general.quip.zhong-hui: A genius scholar with ambitions that were too big. He worked overtime until he burned himself out too.
ui.general.quip.huang-gai: Such a convincing performance with the surrender ruse. A method actor who can exit the scene without a scratch.
ui.general.quip.cheng-pu: The most senior elder of Jiangdong. His words carry weight, and every newcomer has to bow a little.
ui.general.quip.han-dang: Quietly does the work, never fights for credit, and is the steadiest guy on the team.
ui.general.quip.gan-ning: Started as a pirate, led a hundred men on night raids, and turned a life on the road into a real career.
ui.general.quip.ling-tong: A young fierce warrior with boundless energy, always acting like he just finished his third coffee.
ui.general.quip.zhou-tai: Covered in scars like a map. His loyalty to protect the lord is at full power, no question.
ui.general.quip.xu-sheng: Built a fake city wall overnight to fool the enemy. His construction speed would make modern developers jealous.
ui.general.quip.ding-feng: An old but still fierce Jiangdong warrior who charges through the snow. Even in the cold, he gives it his all.
ui.general.quip.zhang-zhao: The Jiangdong chief elder who loves giving blunt advice. Even the boss has to sit up straight in meetings.
ui.general.quip.lu-meng: A soldier who went from ignorance to learning, so much that you have to look at him differently after three days. The ultimate comeback story.
ui.general.quip.sun-ce: The little overlord who conquered the realm with flair, but never once brought a bodyguard along.
ui.general.quip.sun-jian: The Tiger of Jiangdong, first to storm Luoyang. A true fighter who even found the imperial seal.
ui.general.quip.dong-zhuo: Ran the capital like he was the emperor, with a dinner spread bigger than the actual emperor's. Always feels short on prestige.
ui.general.quip.yuan-shao: A noble from four generations of high officials with plenty of resources. The only problem is choosing between too many options.
ui.general.quip.liu-biao: Holds Jingzhou but only wants to keep the status quo. The poster child for the cautious manager, a perfect retirement plan.
ui.general.quip.ma-teng: A Xiliang boss who brought troops into the capital to help the court, only to be treated like a favor debt.
ui.general.quip.gongsun-zan: His white horse cavalry shines wherever they go, but the fuel tank doesn't last long.
ui.general.quip.tao-qian: The kindly man who gave Xuzhou away three times, and only wanted to protect the people. Then got pushed into the top job.
ui.general.quip.liu-zhang: Yi Province is rich but he got cousins to collect the rent. A classic steady-type boss.
ui.general.quip.zhang-lu: A Taoist boss in Hanzhong. Join his faith for five pecks of rice, and the benefits might be the earliest subscription plan.
ui.general.quip.han-sui: An old pro in Liangzhou who switches sides faster than flipping pages. His own calculations are always ringing.
ui.general.quip.yuan-shu: Declared himself emperor at Shouchun with a big ceremony, but nobody showed up to the banquet.
ui.general.quip.kong-rong: A child prodigy who gave up his pear at age four, and grew into a verbal sparring champ who gives the boss headaches.
ui.general.quip.liu-yan: Asked to become governor of Yi Province and dreamed of being an independent local boss, a family startup in a small package.
ui.general.quip.cao-pi: Snatched the throne and forced his brother to write a poem in seven steps. The origin of office talent shows.
ui.general.quip.cao-xiu: A talented youth who was family to the lord and charged into battle with extra enthusiasm. His annual review must look great.
ui.general.quip.sima-zhao: Everyone knows his ambition, even the kids can see it. His acting is clearly not up to par.
ui.general.quip.sima-shi: Went back to work right after eye surgery. Even the boss wants to give him a sick day.
ui.general.quip.zhuge-jin: His younger brother is prime minister on the other side, while he keeps working as usual. The family group chat must be awkward every New Year.
ui.general.quip.zhuge-ke: Sun Quan teased him about his dad, and he wrote two characters to take the donkey home. A born talker from childhood.
ui.general.quip.bu-zhi: Hid from chaos by growing melons when he was young, then climbed all the way to chancellor. Proof that melon farmers can reach the top too.
ui.general.quip.zhu-ran: A classmate and old comrade of Sun Quan who got hired on connections but actually got the job done. Held Jiangling until the enemy wanted to go home.
ui.general.quip.pan-zhang: Poor and fond of drinking, but he made the biggest deal by bringing Guan Yu's head to Dong Wu at Linju. The best salesman of the year.
ui.general.quip.ma-zhong: Such a common name you have to ask which Ma Zhong it is. This one earned his keep at Linju on the Wu side.
ui.general.quip.liu-feng: Thought he'd be the heir, but Liu Bei had a son late in life, and the adopted son became a supporting role in a family drama.
ui.general.quip.meng-da: Switched lords like switching phone carriers, and every plan lasts less than a year before he wants to change again.
ui.general.quip.peng-yang: Complained a few things to Ma Chao after drinking, and it spread. Group chats are clearly not a safe place to vent.
ui.general.quip.fa-zheng: Planned the Battle of Dingjun Mountain beautifully, with a revenge-first attitude. Don't ever make him your enemy.
ui.general.quip.huang-quan: Forced to surrender to Cao Wei, but Shu Han never blamed him. Being respected on both sides is a rare character trait.
ui.general.quip.li-yan: As a trusted minister, when the grain arrived late he came up with excuses. A month-end report manager at heart.
ui.general.quip.wang-ping: Barely knows ten characters, yet cleaned up the mess at Jieting steadily. Proof that a degree isn't everything.
ui.general.quip.zhang-yi: Calmed and controlled the tribes of Yuexi with a mix of kindness and firmness. The emotional management master of the south.
ui.general.quip.liao-hua: With no great generals in Shu, Liao Hua became the vanguard. Long years on the job made him a living legend in the office.
ui.general.quip.guan-xing: His father is Guan Yu, so the pressure is like being a CEO's son joining the company. Everyone watches him closely.
ui.general.quip.zhang-bao: The son of Zhang Fei, and I'm not sure his voice is as loud. He and Guan Xing make a nice second-gen duo.
ui.general.quip.ma-dai: Always the one called in to fill the shift. Whenever the lord calls, he shows up. A textbook firefighter.
ui.general.quip.cao-hong: Gave his horse to his cousin to escape, but kept a tight grip on his wallet. A lifesaver and a frugal relative all in one.
ui.general.quip.cao-zhang: Wrestled wild beasts barehanded, and even the hardest-to-tame golden-eyed hawk stopped fighting him. Animal charm at full power.
ui.general.quip.man-chong: Even the emperor's relative couldn't escape his rules. So honest that the tax office seems to have moved into the army.
ui.general.quip.wang-shuang: A powerful fighter who charges with a flail. His entrance sets the mood on fire, though his name is so common you have to check which one.
ui.general.quip.guo-huai: Guarded the western front against Shu for years, never seeking the spotlight, just keeping the gate. The border security boss.
ui.general.quip.chen-tai: His father is Chen Qun, and his speed in rescuing people beats delivery services. The second-gen hero shines like this.
ui.general.quip.wen-pin: When his boss left, he switched sides, then complained to Cao Cao that the place wasn't guarded well. Even the new boss was moved.
ui.general.quip.le-jin: Short but always the first to charge. Shows that courage matters more at work than height.
ui.general.quip.li-dian: Loves to read and never takes credit. He even works well with Zhang Liao, a rare good partner on the team.
ui.general.quip.chen-qun: Invented the Nine-Rank Official Selection System to grade officials, basically the author of the ancient job-grade chart.
ui.general.quip.hua-xin: Cut ties with his classmate Guan Ning after seeing an official carriage outside the door. That unfollow speed is impressive.
ui.general.quip.wang-lang: A Confucian master who only wanted to reason, but the opponent was even better at arguing. The mic got taken away before he finished.
ui.general.quip.xun-you: Looks silly on the outside, but his stomach is full of tricks. Doesn't interrupt meetings, yet settles everything in one line.
ui.general.quip.cheng-yu: Dreamed of holding the sun in his hands and changed his name to Yu. Luck went straight up after that. A fortune-telling upgrade.
ui.general.quip.liu-ye: Always sees the big picture, and talks differently to each lord. A strategist with great social skills.
ui.general.quip.sun-shao: The first prime minister of Wu, busy writing company rules. The classic early-stage startup chief.
ui.general.quip.gu-yong: Famous for talking little, but every word counts. When he's in the room, the whole place automatically lowers its voice.
ui.general.quip.zhu-jun: Helped Sun Jian, then Sun Quan. A senior elder who's been around the family so long he can make tea for the boss.
ui.general.quip.lv-fan: When managing Sun Ce's accounts, even the young Sun Quan had to file a request for small spending. An iron-willed CFO.
ui.general.quip.sun-huan: Held Yidao against Shu's assault, a young royal who made a name in battle, like a new hire who got a big project.
ui.general.quip.sun-jun: Got power from his royal status, and the court's winds changed with one wave of his hand. Even his coworkers want to take leave.
ui.general.quip.he-qi: Pacified the hill tribes with style, polishing every weapon until it shines. A fashion blogger of the military.
ui.general.quip.lu-kang: Traded wine and medicine with the enemy Yang Hu and trusted him, treating a rival like a pen pal. Probably the friendliest front-line relationship.
ui.general.quip.zhu-huan: Known for his bravery, leading small teams to face Wei forces at Xuxu. Like taking a big project with a small budget.
ui.general.quip.lu-yin: Assigned to Jiaozhou, calmed the locals on day one with gentle policies. A great manager sent abroad.
ui.general.quip.cheng-bing: Read widely, even military books, and his lord relies on him like a walking library.
ui.general.quip.han-xuan: Suspicious by nature, he guarded Changsha and didn't trust even his own generals. The kind of boss who never feels safe.
ui.general.quip.jin-xuan: Guarded Wuling but faced Liu Bei's army like a small shop fighting a chain store. Only hanging on to keep the doors open.
ui.general.quip.liu-du: Surrendered to Liu Bei right away, a decision style that skips every unnecessary process. Efficiency champion.
ui.general.quip.zhao-fan: Suggested marrying his widowed sister-in-law to Zhao Yun to build connections, and got turned down in a single line. A lesson in not matchmaking at work.
ui.general.quip.wen-chou: Known as one of Hebei's twin generals, always appearing and being mentioned together. A tag team of Yuan Shao's pride.
ui.general.quip.yan-liang: Charged to the front at Baima with full force, but became Guan Yu's promotional material. PR went way off the rails.
ui.general.quip.zhang-bao-enemy: Called himself the Earth General, started a family venture with his two older brothers. The slogan was loud, but the team name was just Yellow Turbans.
ui.general.quip.zhang-jue: One bowl of holy water and one slogan gathered hundreds of thousands of fans. Even today, he'd be a top influencer and startup founder.
ui.general.quip.zhang-liang-enemy: The third brother who handled the odd jobs and firefighting in the family business, always living in his big brother's shadow.
ui.general.quip.hua-tuo: Invented the numbing potion and taught the Five Animals exercise. Ancient anesthesiologist and fitness coach, all in one.
ui.general.quip.mi-zhu: Rich enough to fund Liu Bei, and even married his sister to him. A true gold sponsor and brother-in-law.
ui.general.quip.jian-yong: When the lord banned alcohol, he pretended to arrest passersby and laughed at the absurdity, making the ban fall apart without a fight.
ui.general.quip.sun-qian: Ran around for Liu Bei, building connections. A field sales and PR manager whose mouth works harder than his legs.
ui.general.quip.yin-mo: A scholar who specialized in the Zuo Commentary, teaching in Shu. Still researching at home after getting off work.
ui.general.quip.deng-zhi: Diplomatic mission to Dong Wu, never bowing too low or standing too tall, and his sharp words had Sun Quan sign the deal. The top diplomat.
ui.general.quip.yang-yi: Ranked first in logistics scheduling across the whole army, but during the succession vote, the votes never went as planned.
ui.general.quip.fei-yi: Plays chess while approving documents, and gets it all done. The legendary master of multitasking.
ui.general.quip.dong-yun: A human firewall beside the young lord. With him around, not even one bad idea from Huang Hao gets through.
ui.general.quip.xu-shu: Once he joined Cao Cao's camp, he never said a word. The grandfather of passive resistance at work.
ui.general.quip.pang-de: Carried a coffin to work. Such dedication, even the boss wants to give him a raise.
ui.general.quip.zhang-xiu: Surrendered, then rebelled, then surrendered again. His career switching record is more colorful than a job-hopping pro.
ui.general.quip.zhang-xian: The Changsha governor didn't like the Jingzhou boss, so he raised troops and went solo. Early startup courage.
ui.general.quip.liu-bao: Left Lord of the Xiongnu, whose son later made a great name. The ultimate winner dad in the family story.
ui.general.quip.ke-bi-neng: Turned a loose pile of grassland tribes into one big company. The M&A expert of the Xianbei.
ui.general.quip.meng-huo: Captured seven times and went home laughing every time. Looks like he treated the whole thing as a free trial pass.
ui.general.quip.zhu-rong: One throw of his flying knife never misses, and he didn't name himself the god of fire for nothing. Shu troops think twice before facing him.
ui.general.quip.wu-tugu: Confident in his rattan armor, until a fire attack turned him into a free BBQ party.
ui.general.quip.ahui-nan: The third of the Cave Marshals. His presence is like the person who always speaks third in meetings.
ui.general.quip.dong-tu-na: Second of the Cave Marshals, neither here nor there, mostly running behind Meng Huo as the backup.
ui.general.quip.jin-huan-san-jie: A name with four characters that proclaimed himself the number one Cave Marshal. Confidence wins half the battle, and luck decides the other half.
ui.general.quip.yuan-tan: Eldest son but not the chosen heir, so the family succession war was more dramatic than a rich family's inheritance fight.
ui.general.quip.yuan-shang: His father chose him as heir, so his older brother refused to accept it, and the family drama started.
ui.general.quip.yuan-xi: The second brother caught between the big and the youngest. He managed Youzhou and watched the rest quietly.
ui.general.quip.gao-lan: Saw things were going badly at Guandu, so he immediately switched to Cao Cao alongside Zhang He. A decision speed that's hard to match.
ui.general.quip.gao-gan: Used his status as Yuan Shao's nephew to set up his own territory in Bingzhou. A classic family startup team.
ui.general.quip.tian-feng: Always said they'd lose, but the boss refused to listen. The most famous person for saying I told you so.
ui.general.quip.ju-shou: Wrote a whole stack of proposals, and the boss never accepted any of them. Anyone with a job would want to pat his shoulder.
ui.general.quip.guo-tu: Played office politics better than strategy, and his voice is always the first one the boss hears.
ui.general.quip.shen-pei: Defended Ye with a temper harder than the walls. Every surrender letter sent to him got sent back.
ui.general.quip.dong-zhao: Kept suggesting bigger titles for Cao Cao, the master of ideas. The founding father of ancient public relations.
ui.general.quip.han-hao: Strict and trusted by his lord, the kind of senior manager you can leave things to with confidence.
ui.general.quip.wang-yi: My husband runs around outside while I hold the fort at home. When Jicheng was in danger, I was the strongest logistics backup, you know.
ui.general.quip.xi-zhi-cai: An early strategist personally recommended by Xun Yu. Cao Cao loved him, but his term was shorter than expected.
ui.general.quip.mao-jie: Serve the Son of Heaven, cultivate the fields, store military supplies. This is basically Cao Cao's ready-made business plan.
ui.general.quip.lu-su: A generous rich heir who gave away his rice storehouse for free. Even Zhou Yu came knocking when he needed food.
ui.general.quip.huo-yi: Always the first to charge in every big battle. A team leader that makes soldiers feel too embarrassed to slack off.
ui.general.quip.liao-li: Thought he was as talented as Zhuge Liang, and criticized his colleagues, only to be transferred to a remote post.
ui.general.quip.du-qiong: Knows astrology and prophecy, and can write a quarterly fortune report just by looking at the night sky.
ui.general.quip.fei-guan: A cousin and son-in-law of Liu Zhang who still got used after switching to Liu Bei. Networking at its finest.
ui.general.quip.luo-xian: Changed bosses, but still insisted on keeping Yongan in good shape. His dedication deserves a perfect attendance award.
ui.general.quip.jiang-wan: Criticized for not handling affairs, yet stayed calm. He could hold all the gossip of the Yi Province office in his belly.
ui.general.quip.gou-fu: Led the Wudang flying army over mountains without a single pause. The natural choice for a hiking club president.
ui.general.quip.liu-chen: Furious when he heard about surrender, slamming the table. A prince with clear stances and a hot-blooded personality.
ui.general.quip.zhu-bao: Changed sides to the winds as the governor of Qiansheng. His ability to switch with the wind beats the weather forecast.
ui.general.quip.li-hui: Specialist in handling the tough local leaders of the south. Shu's southern customer service director.
ui.general.quip.chen-zhi: Got along well with Huang Hao after taking over, a master of interpersonal networking.
ui.general.quip.zhang-yi-shu: Told Jiang Wei to stop the northern campaigns, yet still joined every expedition. A proper office worker.
ui.general.quip.fu-tong: Refused to surrender while covering the retreat at Yiling, when Wu troops came to persuade him. Such loyalty makes colleagues want to treat him.
ui.general.quip.ma-liang: Five brothers, all talented, but he had the whitest eyebrows and the greatest fame. The center of attention in the family.
ui.general.quip.guan-suo: Hard to find in the history books, but he's everywhere in folk stories. That's the power of legend.
ui.general.quip.yu-fan: Studies the I Ching and still talks back to the boss, even when Sun Quan's drunk and tries to shut him down. Real honesty.
ui.general.quip.chen-wu: A veteran who followed Sun Ce to conquer Jiangdong, a reputation for charging ahead that everyone wants to share.
ui.general.quip.sun-yi: As fiery as his brother Sun Ce, a true Sun family explosive combo.
ui.general.quip.zhu-ji: Father Zhu Ran left a good reputation, so he starts at the front of the line. Pure resource inheritance.
ui.general.quip.quan-cong: Gave away a huge pile of rice to help the needy and recruit people, earning both reputation and connections.
ui.general.quip.lv-dai: Still leading troops at eighty years old. His retirement plan seems to keep getting pushed back.
ui.general.quip.hu-zun: Held a banquet on the pontoon bridge at Dongxing. He treated the battlefield like an end-of-year party, and that's a bold move.
ui.general.quip.wang-ji: Surround first and attack later, steady and careful. He always checks the risks, like a senior engineer.
ui.general.quip.sun-li: Speaks plainly and dares to argue with the powerful Cao Shuang. Coworkers call him the honest big brother.
ui.general.quip.wang-hun: Served both Wei and Jin, and even took part in the conquest of Wu. A veteran who has moved through multiple companies.
ui.general.quip.wen-qin: Bold and always bragging about his own strength. The most confident man in the army, and his son is even stronger.
ui.general.quip.gongsun-yuan: Tried to please both Wei and Wu, but both sides saw through him. Balancing on two boats is seriously thrilling.
ui.general.quip.mu-lu-da-wang: Summoned wild beasts like a zoo show. The pet master of the southern barbarians, with the biggest stage.
ui.general.quip.e-huan: Always charges at the front line in battle, a boss leading from the front, so his men don't dare slack off.
ui.general.quip.sha-mo-ke: Swings iron caltrop clubs with heavy metal sound effects. The five-stream barbarian king, loud and effective.
ui.general.quip.mi-heng: Beat the drum and insulted Cao Cao during his interview. Turned the job interview into a one-man comedy show. Quite the personality.
ui.general.quip.tian-chou: Lived in the mountains with his people, and even guided Cao Cao through the Wuhuan campaign. The ancient local guide.
ui.general.quip.guan-ning: Cut ties with Hua Xin halfway through a friendship, then stayed in Liaodong with great principles. Even wore through his wooden bed.
ui.general.quip.zuo-ci: Cao Cao tried to catch him, so he turned into a flock of sheep and slipped through. Catching people like running a farm. That's a wild imagination.
ui.general.quip.yu-ji: Drew charm water to heal people and gathered so many followers that Sun Ce couldn't sit still. A top-tier ancient influencer.
ui.general.quip.liu-ba: Zhang Fei visited him, but he ignored him. Then he managed Liu Bei's purse perfectly. The cold-faced CFO.
ui.general.quip.qin-mi: Asked if heaven has a head, and he answered yes and explained why. The debating champion who never runs out of arguments.
ui.general.quip.yi-ji: Mocked by Sun Quan while visiting Wu, and he struck back with a single line. Diplomacy at full score.
ui.general.quip.fei-shi: Spoke frankly during the bid for the crown and was transferred away. A classic employee who gives opinions, the boss got mad, but history nodded.
ui.general.quip.zhang-nan: The vanguard of the Yiling campaign who wanted to break through with long spears. Charging faster than a company rushing a project.
ui.general.quip.fu-shou: When he was rear guard, he shouted that a Han general never surrenders. Took the surrender option right off the menu.
ui.general.quip.sun-sheng: Wrote history straight without fear. Even the people in power found him hard to deal with. The editor who never worries about offending anyone.
ui.general.quip.wei-zhao: Stuck to facts while writing the history of Wu, refused to make Sun Hao's dad look like an emperor. A principled chief editor.
ui.general.quip.xue-zong: Taunted an envoy from Shu by splitting his surname into characters, leaving him speechless. Such a sharp tongue, it's like a blade.
ui.general.quip.zhu-yi: Had his own opinions when leading troops, even questioned orders from above. A general who doesn't just blindly obey.
ui.general.quip.pan-jun: Guarded Jingzhou for Sun Quan with only official business. Even friends and relatives couldn't get a favor from him.
ui.general.quip.cao-zhi: The living definition of genius. Seven steps for a poem sounds like an on-the-spot assignment that somehow scored top marks.
ui.general.quip.lv-kai: Held Yongchang and refused to surrender to rebels, then presented a map to defeat the southern barbarians, like a head start on Zhuge Liang's strategy.
ui.general.quip.chen-dao: Guarded Yongan with the White Feather Troops. Second only to Zhao Yun in fame, like the eternal deputy who is never less capable.
ui.general.quip.wu-ban: Charged through the lines with long spears, unstoppable. Wu Ban is the heavy colleague who comes with his own bulldozer sound effect.
ui.general.quip.sun-hao: The last emperor of Wu, and the summary says he could break any formation, but later generations remember him as a whimsical boss who loved playing.
ui.general.quip.diao-chan: Made one extra glance at a banquet throw Dong Zhuo and Lu Bu into chaos. I'm just very good at eye management, and the situation collapses by itself, you know.
ui.general.quip.da-qiao: Never wanted the spotlight, just quietly held the family together on the Sun side. The real backstage manager of Jiangdong is quite something, isn't it.
ui.general.quip.xiao-qiao: I only adjusted Zhou Yu's sharpness to just the right level at the governor's mansion, and later generations made me into a postcard before the Battle of Red Cliffs.
ui.general.quip.zhen-ji: Knows when to stay quiet. Surviving in a harsh palace workplace longer than most men. That's how you get along, you know!
ui.general.quip.sun-shang-xiang: Even when marrying, she brought a whole squad of guards. Even Liu Bei moving in felt like checking into someone else's territory. This is my aura!
ui.general.quip.cai-yan: Turned her hardships into Eighteen Stanzas of the Reed Pipe. Essentially a permanent cloud backup of a hard time.
ui.general.quip.huang-yue-ying: People said she was plain but clever. Actually she's an engineer who understands farm tools and machines. She can talk about machines with Zhuge Liang more than gossip, you know!
ui.general.quip.zhang-chun-hua: I handle risk fast and precisely. I'm the Sima family's risk control officer, and I patch the weak spots before they even show up, you know.
ui.general.quip.xin-xian-ying: I don't need to shout. I sense the situation and predict what happens next. Listen to my advice and you'll save yourself a lot of trouble later.
ui.general.quip.bu-lian-shi: I don't fight or grab for power. I smooth out the atmosphere in the inner palace with gentle, steady ways. The perfect office peacemaker with top emotional intelligence!
ui.general.quip.guan-yin-ping: I carry my family's name as a responsibility. When it's time to fight, I fight. I refuse to be just a family photo hanging on a wall!
ui.general.quip.lu-ling-qi: I'm the daughter of the flying general, so fast that even my cape can't keep up. I won't waste the sharpness my father left me!
ui.general.quip.ma-yun-lu: Grew up in the Xiliang sand winds. As soon as I'm on the horse field, every horse goes quiet. That kind of aura doesn't need anyone to name it!
ui.general.quip.dong-bai: I was pushed into being a noble family's young daughter so early that my schedule is fuller than a toy box. When would I have time for an ordinary childhood, you know?
ui.general.quip.fan-shi: I never went to the front lines, yet everyone treated me as a bargaining chip. I'm sure you all understand this feeling of being arranged.
ui.general.quip.bian-fu-ren: I went from a songstress to head of the inner palace. Cao Cao fights outside, and I keep the sons in line at home. Now that's a low-key general manager!
ui.general.quip.wu-guo-tai: I'm the senior guardian at the Ganlu Temple matchmaking. Before anyone draws a sword, I've already smoothed the emotions and face of both families, you know!
ui.general.quip.guo-nu-wang: I didn't win favor by fighting. I stood in the right place at the right time, rising from attendant to empress. That's the true promotion strategy, you know!
ui.general.quip.wang-yuan-ji: I can tell what people think just from a few words. I can see the dark side before the Sima family does. This kind of foresight is natural, you know.
ui.general.quip.xiahou-shi: I'm a Xiahou daughter married to Zhang Fei, and I stitched the two families together. Even that hot-tempered husband is totally under my control!
ui.general.quip.xiahou-ling-nv: I hold on to my principles and refuse to remarry. Neither family law nor the times can shake my will. Such stubbornness is principle-level, you know!
ui.general.quip.gan-shi: I followed Liu Bei through every move and never became a burden. I'm not just a blood symbol as Ashi's mother. I'm the steady center of the home, you know.
ui.general.quip.mi-shi: I protected the children in the chaos at Changban, yet the legends put all the sacrifice filter on me. This overtime is so heavy, you know!
ui.general.quip.cao-jie: I held on to the jade seal and wouldn't give it up easily. Even when the situation was settled, I still stood up and voiced my opposition. A queen's version of a public no vote!
ui.general.quip.sun-lu-ban: They didn't call me Big Tiger for nothing. I run all the royal feuds, and turning family matters into a drama is also a talent, don't you think!
ui.general.quip.sun-lu-yu: I'm Little Tiger, and I don't like noise. I'm so restrained that I never speak first in meetings. That quietness is a disadvantage in the Sun family, you know.
ui.general.quip.zhao-e: I didn't wait for a man to help. I sharpened my blade and took revenge for my father myself. I earned the name of a righteous woman with actions, you know!
ui.general.quip.yang-hui-yu: I don't show my emotions. Like a roof beam, I quietly hold up the Yang family. No matter how much noise or chaos there is around, my part keeps running smoothly.
ui.general.quip.zhu-rong-furen: I threw one flying knife and wounded Ma Dai, and captured Zhang Yi. The descendant of the fire god, every Shu general has to respect me on the battlefield!
ui.general.quip.bao-san-niang: I was a mountain bandit queen before, and after Guan Xing beat me into submission, I got married as well. From martial arts to romance, all in one, you know!
ui.general.quip.hua-man: I fought with dual blades, got caught by Ma Dai, then released by Zhuge Liang. Captured yet got the good-person card, quite a special story!
ui.general.quip.cai-shi: I pushed Liu Cong to take the throne and wrote to Cao Cao to take over Jingzhou. No soldier moved, but the ownership changed hands. Even the mergers envy this efficiency!
ui.general.quip.cao-hua: I entered the palace with my two older sisters. I'm not one to show off, and in the big storm of Han and Wei swapping shifts, I'm the steady one who protects everyday life.
ui.general.quip.cao-xian: I'm good at settling sisters' little fights with one sentence. The role of a palace relations mediator sounds like it was made just for me!
ui.general.quip.xu-shi: I pretended to obey while secretly contacting Bian Hong, and at the banquet I defended my husband's honor. This move of retreating to advance made even Sun Quan send a gift!
